name: PublicBench-v2 (X-Humans part)
why: PREREG 'PublicBench-v2' = PublicBench-v1 (publicbench_v1.json, unchanged) + these X-Humans subjects; same fairness rule.

protocol.source: source_frame = the first training frame; single-image methods see only this frame
protocol.recon: recon_frames = all frames of the official TRAIN takes; per-subject methods train on these only
protocol.test: test_frames = all frames of the official TEST takes; every method is scored on exactly these
protocol.driving: GT rows: the dataset's SMPL-X of each test frame (SMPL-X 2020 fitted to it; SMPL fitted for SMPL methods); SPRINT rows: SPRINT
protocol.mask: rendered depth < 100 (exact); GT = image x mask on black
protocol.crop: AvatarTest-v1 perspective crop: projected GT mesh box clipped to the image, 1.1 x, 1024 px; scored at 512

composition.pool: the 3 X-Humans subjects of ExAvatar's X-Humans evaluation (user decision)

licences.xhumans: X-Humans (Shen et al., CVPR 2023; ETH Zurich AIT, https://xhumans.ait.ethz.ch): non-commercial academic research only; no redistribution of the data or of converted data; never used for training. Body model: SMPL-X (MPI non-commercial licence).

clips.part: full body, rendered RGB of textured scans (moving virtual camera, white background)
clips.frame_index: frame = take * 10000 + n, n = 1-based number of render/image/color_<n>.png (= SMPLX/mesh-f<n>_smplx.pkl)

published_split.source: X-Humans official train / test folders (README table)

gt.kind: X-Humans SMPL-X registration (SMPL-X v1.1, gendered, flat_hand_mean False, 10 expr), betas = mean_shape_smplx.npy
